metadata.title: टिपरा मोथा मोदी के रथ पर सवार होगी | Will Tipra Motha join NDA before LokSabha polls
metadata.description:
Tipra Motha, the prominent opposition party in the Tripura assembly, serves as the voice of the indigenous community within the state. With a resolute commitment to advocating for a greater Tipraland for indigenous groups, the party has garnered significant attention and support.
Following the elections, Pradyut Kishor Manikya, the esteemed leader of Tipra Motha, asserted that the central government was willing to engage in discussions by appointing interlocutors to address the pressing issue. However, despite the assurances, neither he nor his party received any communication from the central government representatives, leaving them disheartened and disillusioned.
In response to the lack of progress, Pradyut Kishor Manikya took a bold stand by announcing his intent to embark on a fast unto death, underscoring the urgency and gravity of the matter. 
In a recent development, the central government has extended an invitation to Pradyut Kishor Manikya to journey to Delhi for discussions.
